title: HushSpec Trusted Keyring v0.2
description: The set of public keys a verifier trusts for policy signatures. Normative prose: spec/hushspec-signing.md section 5. A verifier MUST select the key whose key_id equals the envelope's key_id and MUST NOT fall back to any other key.

key_id.description: sha256 of the DER-encoded SubjectPublicKeyInfo in public_key. Verifiers MUST recompute it from public_key and reject the entry if it differs.

public_key.description: The public key as a PEM-encoded SubjectPublicKeyInfo (RFC 7468 'PUBLIC KEY').

not_after.description: Signatures whose signed_at is at or after this instant MUST be rejected for this key. Lets a key be retired without invalidating signatures made before retirement.

revoked.description: When true, every signature by this key MUST be rejected regardless of signed_at.
